entities.name: Cenicriviroc
observations: Dual CCR2/CCR5 antagonist; evaluated as add-on to stable ART in people with HIV.

entities.name: PMID:32013805
observations: In a 24-week open-label study of ART-suppressed people with HIV (plasma HIV RNA <50 copies/mL), CVC treatment was associated with changes in plasma fibrosis markers; this report did not demonstrate viral release or intracellular HIV-DNA decline.

entities.name: PMID:33727362
observations: In vitro, CVC reduced transmigration of HIV-bearing ART-treated monocytes across a blood-brain barrier model; this supports inhibition of cell trafficking, not release of HIV into extracellular plasma.
